thread:
mira.design: Quick design check: added a micro-tutorial overlay that appears after a user finishes the setup checklist. Two steps, very small: (1) make a test API call, (2) open sample project. Staging: https://staging.console.redwood-inference.com/onboard/micro-tut :mag_right:
lee_frontend: Nice and lightweight. One issue: overlay traps tab focus and there's no clear close via keyboard. Repro: tab through checklist -> overlay appears -> tab stops at overlay but can't reach close button with shift+tab.
sam_access: Accessibility notes: overlay must set focus to the first interactive element on open and restore focus on close. Provide an escape key handler and add role="dialog" with aria-modal="true". Also include descriptive aria-label like 'Onboarding micro tutorial'.
alex_pm: Metrics: primary goal is conversion to first API call. Secondary is sample-open rate. Add tracking events tut.open, tut.api_call, tut.sample_open. We'll A/B test micro-tut vs no overlay.
devon_devex: I'll add events and include variant id and elapsed_ms in payload. Also capture if user dismisses overlay.
lee_frontend: I'll switch overlay to a11y-first pattern: focus trap with focus-lock lib, Escape to close, and restore focus to the originating element. Also will ensure close button is visible at small breakpoints.
qa-bot: QA note: on Firefox the overlay's backdrop blocks pointer events to the top nav; filing ticket QA-402. Screenshot attached in ticket.
mira.design: Copy candidates (small): A) 'Quick tour: make a test call' B) 'Try a quick API call' C) 'Run a test request' Which is clearest?
alex_pm: B is concise and action-oriented.
sam_access: For screen reader announce full context: include hidden text 'This tutorial helps you make your first API call and open a sample project.' so SR users know what's inside before interacting.
lee_frontend: Implementation note: using lazy load for sample list inside overlay to avoid heavy payload. Will show spinner skeleton for sample cards.
devon_devex: Also plan to log ttf (time to first API call) and funnel drop-off after tut.open.
mira.design: Thanks! I'll update the mock with the SR text and new copy, then push to design-assets. Can folks review the PR when it's up?
deploy-bot: New deploy to staging: onboard/micro-tutorial @ 2025-01-09T12:02:10Z :rocket:
alex_pm: If fixes look good in QA, let's run the experiment for 10 days and evaluate api-key creation + first-call rate. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
